template.title: Flexible job shop instance {name}
template.statement: Schedule the operations of instance {name}, each on one of its machines, so that each job's operations run in order, no machine runs two operations at once, and the makespan (the latest end) is as small as possible.
template.submission: Text file: one line per job: for each of its operations the machine chosen and the start time (integers); the instance file is fetched by fetch.sh into {file}; see checkers/jsp_check.py.

best_text: The best known makespan is {best} ({holder}); a valid schedule with a shorter makespan improves it.
bound_source: the best known lower bound in the keeper's archive
holder_sources: the solver or publication of the archive's earliest entry with the best upper bound
open_rule: every instance whose best known lower bound is below its best known upper bound in the keeper's archive
